narrative.overview:
The page is one sheet of ink on paper. Instrument Sans carries every proportional sentence; Geist Mono annotates it — dates, locations, roles, annotations. A 672px column keeps prose at a reading measure even when the shell is wide. There is no photography, no display face, and no chromatic accent; a full-bleed half globe closes the page, its pins marking where the work happened. The CV should read as a document that happens to be interactive, not as a product surface wearing a CV.

Density is deliberate: 12px card prose under 16px entry titles under 20px section headings, with 32px between sections. Cards are paper sheets separated by a hairline ring rather than elevation. Interaction lives at the edges — 32px icon buttons — and all of it disappears in print. A restrained 12px rise plus opacity marks entry and scroll, once per element; the document is fully readable with motion disabled.

The confirmed component direction is soft lifted surfaces: a layered-paper feel. Today that lift is carried by rounded corners and a 1px ink/10 ring; any shadow added to content must stay low-contrast and single-layer, so the page keeps its document character.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic palette; hierarchy by size and weight, never hue.
One proportional family (Instrument Sans) plus Geist Mono for metadata.
Flat content sheets with hairline rings; the only shadow is the control-rest under icon buttons.
One authored reveal language, once per element, removed under reduced motion and in print.
Print is a first-class output: chrome hides, contacts become text.
A full-bleed half globe closes the page at the bottom edge; pins mark physical experience locations, with the current role distinguished.

rules.name: The No-Hue Rule
rules.body: The interface carries zero chroma. The chromatic moments in the product — fuchsia text selection, confetti on certification hover, the emerald console signature — are easter eggs, not tokens. They never appear as layout color, state color, or emphasis in the CV itself.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is expressed with weight, size, and spacing. If a change needs a color to read as important, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks data about the document — dates, locations, roles, handles, annotations. It never sets a paragraph, a highlight, or a section title.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: Instrument Sans carries every proportional glyph; Geist Mono carries annotations. Do not add a third family, a serif display face, or a second mono; hierarchy comes from scale and weight inside the pair.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a 1px ink/10 ring before any shadow is considered. Two competing separation devices on one surface is a bug.

rules.name: The Control-Only Rule
rules.body: The only shadow on the page is the control-rest under an icon button. Content, cards, and page chrome stay flat.

dos: Do keep the CV column at 672px and the content measure inside it; wider prose breaks the spec-sheet character.
Do carry hierarchy with weight and size before touching color.
Do set metadata — dates, locations, roles, annotations — in Geist Mono at 12–14px.
Do separate cards with the 1px ink/10 ring; when applying the confirmed soft lift, pair it with that hairline instead of replacing it.
Do reserve the control-rest shadow for icon buttons; content stays flat.
Do keep the reveal to one 12px rise plus opacity, 450ms ease-out, once per element; grouped items wait 60ms.
Do ship content visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion; print forces every reveal visible.
Do reveal a card immediately on keyboard focus, without waiting for the transition.
Do keep the footer globe monochrome and pinned to physical experience locations; keep its static SVG wireframe and pins for no-JS and reduced motion.
Do keep the half globe flush to the page's bottom edge, with no margin or padding below it.
Do let the globe be dragged, keyboard-rotated, and focused from its place list, and pause its render loop when offscreen.
Do leave remote roles unpinned; name them in the legend instead of inventing a coordinate.
Do generate /og.png from the CV view model with Satori and Resvg; never hand-maintain the social image.
Do hide contact icons in print and expose email and phone as text.
Do keep the avatar as initials; it is the only identity mark.
Do use the 2px ink focus outline with its 2px offset; a low-contrast halo is not a focus indicator.
donts: Don't introduce a chromatic accent into the UI. Selection fuchsia, confetti, and the console signature stay outside the system.
Don't add a second typeface or a serif/display face; Instrument Sans and Geist Mono are the whole voice.
Don't use pure black, hue-tinted grays, or darkened borders for emphasis.
Don't stack multiple shadows on content surfaces or add glow effects.
Don't add parallax, scroll-jacking, or layout animation; the only looping motion is the footer globe's idle rotation, and reduced motion removes it.
Don't hide content behind a reveal without the reduced-motion and no-JS fallback.
Don't load Cobe above the fold or on reduced motion, and don't add photography, a headshot, or a logo wall around the globe.
Don't add a bottom margin, bottom padding, or a border under the half globe; the page ends at the clipped sphere.
Don't fabricate a map pin for a remote role.
Don't widen cards or the reading column beyond 672px.
Don't add dark mode without an explicit theme decision; the stylesheet declares color-scheme: light and carries no dark tokens.
Don't add a headshot, logo wall, decorative illustration, or background texture.
